biotools.summary: The HoloFood Data Portal provides access to multi-omic datasets, phenotypic characteristics, and metadata generated by the HoloFood project, which investigates host-microbiota interactions in salmon and chicken production. The portal simplifies access to data from multiple repositories and links related datasets.
